prompts.prompt: Production terrain MATERIAL atlas for the existing WWII top-down tactical game. Reference 1 is the existing summer grass texture showing correct painterly microdetail scale; reference 2 is approved five-season art direction. Create a perfectly square image, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of equal square material tiles, tiles touching with ZERO gutters, borders, shadows, captions, text or perspective. Each cell fills its entire square with a flat orthographic seamless ground texture, homogeneous distribution with modest local variation and subtle fine painterly detail at game scale. No individual scene, roads through landscape, isolated objects, trees, rocks larger than gravel, horizon or lighting gradients. Every cell independent and can be tiled in all directions. Row-major cell meanings: 1 grass surface, 2 rough mud surface, 3 bare soil surface; 4 forest floor surface (no tree crowns or branches), 5 water surface (no banks), 6 deeper/darker water surface (no banks); 7 pale gray fine gravel road SURFACE ONLY, no road edges or markings; 8 compacted bare courtyard earth with sparse gravel, 9 weathered wood plank surface seen directly above (not a bridge or object). Avoid speckled glitter and bright water foam; surfaces should not compete with units. Match existing fine illustrated natural textures, not photo, not pixel art. SPRING: fresh restrained sage / light olive grass with fine new shoots over earth, NOT neon or yellow summer grass; dark moist brown granular mud; neutral wet brown soil; forest floor darker earthy olive with a little new green grass; medium cool blue-teal rippled water and deep cool blue-green water, no whitecaps; pale damp gray gravel; moist muted brown-gray courtyard earth; dull damp gray-brown wood.
